lines.text: David cries out to God as the waters rise to his neck, and his throat is parched.
Those who hate David without cause outnumber the hairs of his head, and zeal for God's house has made him a stranger to his brothers.
David wept and fasted and wore sackcloth, and those who sit at the gate mock him.
David asks God to rescue him from the mire, but he finds comforters in his brothers, and his enemies give him vinegar.

wrong_details.wrong: he finds comforters in his brothers
wrong_details.true: he looked for comforters but found no one

lines.text: David will praise God in song, which pleases the LORD more than silver, and God will save Zion and rebuild Judah's cities.

wrong_details.true: more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves
